attempt_notes: The immutable candidate configured, built and passed all 34 runtime cases plus two separate header checks on each Mac on the first run. No product correction, tolerance relaxation, dependency change or host payload fallback. Heavy builds/tests ran serially, build2/CTest1, actual Metal GPU. Mini signs correctness/portability only. Header scripts check their declared standalone configuration; enabled native headers are also consumed by the product/tests.
coverage: Gather uses six source storage types (F32/F16/BF16/I32/I64/Bool), both I32/I64 indices, scalar/1D/2D indices, repeated and boundary indices, rank8, native transpose/broadcast and exact storage-bit oracles. Large I64 source values use raw-bit checks. Checked and valid unchecked paths pass; negative, extent and integer extrema fail without publishing a result or changing input/retained results.

I32/F32 Scan uses independent exact-range FP64 prefix oracles over width0/1/17/127/129/1025/8193/65537, native transpose, middle/negative axis and inclusive/exclusive modes. Finite integer oracle sums are exact in FP64. F32 NaN/infinities, temporary positive/negative integer overflow followed by recovery, and final-total-only exclusive overflow are covered; integer failures leave functional inputs unchanged.

Preparation retains reachable checked expressions as one hidden status output in the same native stream. Warm evaluation does not adjudicate payload errors. Captured bad constants prepare then fail at invocation, first nonzero registered error wins, discarded expressions have no effect, and cold trace exceptions restore the collector. Checked lowering outside managed tracing rejects explicitly.

Empty source axis with nonempty output fails safely, while empty indices or empty output perform no payload checks. Failed invocations retire; fresh invocations on the same Context recover. Old result arrays survive later failure and close. A deterministic test-only native checkpoint holds a real accepted GPU prefix while Program/Invocation owners are released, then the actual checked failure completes safely. Abandoned completion and existing OOM/cancel/late-native-failure/drain tests pass.

Ordinary Graph uses I64 token IDs and F16/BF16 embedding Gather->mixed-F32 RMSNorm->residual, I32 counts->exclusive Scan, and F32 gate->Softplus->Scan. Shapes rows/width/experts1/129/17,17/2048/128,23/129/257,128/2048/129 use diagnostic tables, not actual model weights. Three public outputs exclude private status. Same-lower Direct bit comparisons and independent FP64/storage-rounding/index/prefix oracles pass across two slots, three changed inputs, destroyed source Graph, retained old results, index/overflow failure and fresh-slot recovery.
cost_structure: HYLE collects checked expressions and traverses reachability only during cold native tracing. Reachable checks add one hidden I32 logical scalar output per program; unchecked programs add none. Existing native synchronization precedes the final status read. Actual MLX allocation/temporary costs remain charged; there is no claim of a physical four-byte allocation or zero-allocation replay.

Gather checks/reduces native indices and safely clamps before Take; floating storage uses same-width integer views to preserve bits. Nonempty output and index counts are bounded by INT32_MAX, dimensions by native int. Empty output skips payload. Layout/materialization and checks are included in eventual performance scope.

I32 Scan promotes to native I64, checks every inclusive prefix including the final exclusive total, then casts a successful result to I32. Exclusive output shifts prefixes rather than subtracting the current value. F32 uses native cumsum. Both are O(N); I64 full-size storage, status reduction, conversions and native layout work are charged.
